radiology_report:
Subject: Prostate Multiparametric MRI | Date: 15 Feb 2025 | Facility: Radboudumc

Clinical Indication:
Assessment requested due to a current serum prostate-specific antigen concentration of 9.3 ng/mL alongside a previous PI-RADS 4 classification.

FINDINGS:
Measured organ bulk totals 31.46 mL. T2 sequences highlight a discrete hypointense area situated at the left peripheral zone base-to-mid transition, spanning roughly 14 mm at its widest point. Apparent diffusion coefficient mapping confirms pronounced restriction, mirrored by dark signal on the DWI traces. Contrast kinetics demonstrate early, localized uptake compared to adjacent tissue. Bilateral seminal vesicles retain normal architecture. Margins remain intact with no extracapsular spread or suspicious nodal enlargement detected. Visually, the bladder and rectal walls appear intact.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 4 lesion in the left peripheral zone (base-to-mid), 14 mm.
Prostate volume: 31.46 mL.
PSA density: 0.296 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.8335312.
